content.short: Filebase is a simplified decentralized file storage protocol.
content.description: Storing data for a dApp can be complex, but Filebase simplifies the process with intuitive drag-and-drop functionality. It operates alongside base-layer storage protocols like IPFS and Skynet, helping developers manage decentralized data without getting bogged down in infrastructure. With more than 25,000 users and over one billion files uploaded, Filebase remains one of the leading storage protocols in Web3, empowering projects to focus on building features rather than storage logistics.
